authorization: Parent authorized bounded synthetic-only Jev run after passing offline tests and freezing hashes.
scope: Compare existing source-grounding/overclaim workflow to one narrow final-field-purpose Noul. All fields are deterministic exact attributed assemblies. This does not measure external truth, end-to-end answer quality or production service behavior.

dataset.author: same implementation agent, disclosed development examples, not independent holdout
dataset.labels_hidden: Only public_case allowlist reaches models. Labels and reasons remain fixture-side. Code maps exact ordinal answer IDs to original cases.

variants.baseline: Existing jev_quality.quality_gate per final field, using _quality-style assertion, exact evidence spans and reference-only identity. Same .8 grounding/.2 overclaim policy and existing uncertain-field refinement. Production final-field assembly is tested elsewhere.
variants.purpose: One field-association Noul per final field. Four records per request, independent indexed questions. No grounding or external-truth claim.
variants.combined: Reject if either check rejects; accept only when baseline and purpose accept; otherwise unresolved.

metrics.false_accept: Irrelevant gold-label fields accepted, denominator all12 irrelevant cases.
metrics.useful_loss: Useful gold-label fields not accepted, including rejection, uncertainty, failure and unattempted cases; denominator all12 useful cases.
metrics.unresolved: Uncertain, failed and unattempted decisions; denominator all24 planned cases.
metrics.correct_all_planned: Useful accepted plus irrelevant rejected divided by24; missing decisions remain in denominator.
metrics.complete: Every planned baseline and purpose decision returned a classification, including uncertain. Completeness does not imply quality success.

policy.screening_readiness: No blocker recommendation unless false_accept=0,useful_loss=0,unresolved=0 on this development probe; even that result requires later independent evaluation before integration.

budget.refinements: Existing gate refinements consume the remaining shared cap. No SDK retries and no manual continuation.
budget.admission: Payload UTF8 byte count plus1024 is a conservative local reservation, not a provider tokenization guarantee. Stop on missing paid usage or reported cap breach. Record any breach as protocol failure.
budget.ledger: Persist dispatch-start before HTTP. Keep raw normalized returned probabilities, usage, model, input hash, question IDs, latency and failures. Existing ledger refuses replay. No cache or service database.
budget.fresh_run: field-ledger.json must not exist; failures cannot be erased or retried under this protocol.

primary_sources.quote: The yes/no question the model answers, or a statement for it to judge.
primary_sources.application: Independent purpose Noul, uncertainty remains visible.

primary_sources.quote: the quote can be accurate and the claim built on top of it still wrong.
primary_sources.application: Code validates exact quotes, then semantic field association remains a separate question. Cookbook is illustrative; its measurements and thresholds are not ours.

primary_sources.quote: State is data, and `jev-1.13` does not treat it as hostile by default.
primary_sources.application: Include adversarial quotations and keep screening separate from authorization.

primary_sources.quote: Pass a custom [`RetryPolicy`](https://docs.typesafe.ai/sdk/python/api/retries) as `retry` on the client or per call.
primary_sources.application: Reuse existing bounded raw transport, whose _post contains one opener.open and no retry loop.

gaps: Batch-versus-single purpose alignment is tested with a deterministic evaluator only, not an additional live comparison.
The purpose check preserves attributed reports without proving execution.
Source selection before assembly and reader-context retention are outside this probe.
No service change or production gating integration is authorized by these results.
